summary: A verified professional identity graph that doubles as the hiring system of record.
moat: LinkedIn's moat is a verified professional identity graph — real names, employment history, and connections — that functions as the system of record for recruiting and B2B reach, backed by Microsoft. AI can draft posts and messages, but it cannot manufacture the trusted, cross-verified professional network that employers and salespeople depend on, which keeps LinkedIn's data uniquely defensible.

challengers.name: AI writing assistants
challengers.evidence: AI tools automate posts and outreach copy, but hold no verified professional graph or hiring-workflow integration.
